notes.title: Devlog September
notes.content: [h3]Ahoy Deckhands![/h3][p][/p][p]In the past few months, we’ve been sailing full speed ahead with development. Bugs have been fixed, features added, enemies balanced, interfaces created… It’s quite a long list, but we’d like to share the most important highlights:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Quest system[/b]. Sailing the seas is now more entertaining than ever. This is also the first step toward building the story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New promotion system[/b]. Based on the feedback we’ve received.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New professions.[/b] Since the promotion system is richer than ever, we’ve introduced three new professions to do it justice: the Cook, the Shooter, and the Deckhand.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New cards[/b]. Not much more to add here.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay changes[/b]. You can now fire more times… before firing even more times.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock system[/b]. Professions, cards, and trinkets now need to be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy AI improvements[/b]. To make them a challenge that’s tough but still fun.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interface improvements[/b]. Now they’re more consistent and polished.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat effect upgrades[/b]. Because a cannon shot is always better when it looks powerful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main menu[/b]. We had one before, but it needed a little love.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]The [b]LamaGlama Games[/b] crew.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Join the Seek & Sail journey
notes.content:
[h2][b]Welcome aboard, Captain![/b][/h2]

You’ve found the Seek & Sail logbook, and that can only mean one thing:
you’ve been chosen to be part of the founding crew!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594671/135754a63bdeb08519858d8a9179ebce35a196d6.png[/img]
[b]There are no passengers here.[/b]
Every sailor matters, every decision counts, and every card can change the course of your journey.

[b]What is Seek & Sail?[/b]
Seek & Sail is a pirate-themed roguelike deckbuilder where every card, every crew member, and every choice can lead you to glory... or to the bottom of the ocean.
We’re preparing for an Early Access launch later this year, and you can be among the first to chart the course.

[b]What will you find here?[/b]
[list]
[*] Development news and updates.
[*] First looks at cards, professions, and bosses.
[*] Polls where your opinion will help us navigate.
[*] Surprises, challenges… and the occasional shipwreck.
[/list]


[b]How can you get involved?[/b]
[list]
[*] Add Seek & Sail to your wishlist.
[*] Follow us here on Steam to stay up to date.
[*] Introduce yourself in the comments — we want to meet all the brave sailors on board!
[*] Join the Discord crew:
[/list]

https://discord.gg/UPhyhq3e57

The LamaGlama Games Team.
